text: A person in a purple shirt sits at a pottery wheel, expertly shaping a tall, flared clay vessel with their hands. They work in a sunlit studio filled with pottery tools and various ceramic pieces. A second person is partly visible, and large windows overlook green foliage.

A bearded man in a brown shirt sits on a sofa, holding a black vaping device to his mouth. He inhales, then exhales a large cloud of white vapor upwards with a smile. A woman sits on another sofa in the background, looking down. The room has white walls with a red stripe.

Two women sit facing each other in a plain room. The woman on the right, holding a pen, suddenly turns away, then back, covering her face and laughing. The blonde woman in a pink hoodie smiles at her, watching her reaction.

A bearded man in a dark shirt plays a black and silver drum kit in a recording studio. He holds drumsticks, striking the large cymbals and various drums. Sound-dampening panels with a grid pattern line the walls behind him, along with wooden beams.

In a bright kitchen, a woman in an apron holds a glass bowl of cake batter. A chef in a white uniform uses a spatula to scrape the light-colored batter into a round metal baking pan. They are preparing to bake on a dark countertop with white cabinets in the background.

A man in a white shirt and backpack stands in a crowded outdoor pedestrian area, holding a camera. He smiles and films the diverse group of people walking and standing around him, next to a building with large display panels.

A young boy with a backpack walks on a sidewalk next to a street with cars. He pulls a blue and white jacket over his head, then quickly removes it, smiling. He then runs forward, looking back playfully, as a woman walks a black dog behind him, with houses and mountains in the distance.

A person in a white shirt and red shorts bounces high on a trampoline inside a brightly lit shopping mall. They repeatedly jump several feet into the air next to a tall pillar displaying a large watch advertisement and various store signs.

A five-man band performs on a stage under bright blue and green spotlights. The central musician plays a red and white accordion, while others play saxophones and a trumpet. Drums and congas are visible behind them. All wear white shirts and light pants, actively playing their instruments.
